items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I think it was -- about '65, when he went down -- no, 60-something, when Jake Hannah joined the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, fancy that. That's nice, that's very nice, isn't it, because not a lot of people are going to say that.

Just like Woody Herman. Well, I played on the big bands, too, see. And I'm trying to -- let's see, I think it was -- about '65, when he went down -- no, 60-something, when Jake Hannah joined the band.
